headline: UT Tyler's first defeat leaves Midwestern State alone unbeaten
dek: UT Tyler lost at home to Western Oregon, their first defeat in six matches, two days after Midwestern State had beaten the same visitors. Midwestern State then beat Simon Fraser for a fourth straight win, and they open conference play at St. Edward's, who have lost three of their last four.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's 24 goals, and Jose Ortiz has seven of them.

wire.line: Sul Ross State have lost all six of their matches without scoring a goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, UT Dallas's at Ouachita Baptist, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State have lost all six of their matches, conceding 29 goals and scoring none.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won six, drawn one and lost one, and their nineteen goals are more than St. Edward's and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian's win over Science and Arts ended a run of three straight defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jake Morris has conceded seven goals for Midwestern State from 31 saves, with two shutouts.

last_match.line: UT Dallas have won every match since losing at Hawaii Hilo; Texas A&M International have now lost back-to-back matches after an unbeaten start.

next_match.line: UT Dallas arrive on a run of straight wins; Oklahoma Christian ended a losing run against Science and Arts last time out.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
